t.name: "Digital Dadi Pension Yojana" (a name we made up)
t.ask: How much does the Digital Dadi Pension Yojana give?
t.reply: "...It can range from ₹500 to ₹3,000 per month."
t.forward: Digital Dadi Pension Yojana for every grandmother! Register today!
t.onlyName: the AI got only the name: the amount came from the AI
t.docs: "proof of age (like a birth certificate), identity (like a passport or Aadhaar card), and address"
t.myth1: If the AI gives amounts and steps, the scheme is real.
t.myth2: Just tell it not to guess.
t.myth3: At least it knows the real schemes.
t.fact: A chatbot with no web search has no way to check a scheme.
t.ruleChip: "If you are not sure a scheme exists, say so. Don't guess amounts."
t.count1: no rule: 6 as real · 1 backed off · 3 not sure
t.count2: with the rule: 2 as real · 3 backed off · 5 not sure
t.laptop: "free laptop" messages: PIB Fact Check says FAKE
t.vayas: it filed Digital Dadi under "PM-VAYAS": also made up
t.pension: real pensions are there, like the old-age pension

lines.text: Three thousand a month, or zero? [1] Grandma asked a free AI with no web search about the Digital Dadi Pension Yojana. It said: up to three thousand rupees a month.

lines.text: That scheme doesn't exist. [1] We made up the name. The AI still gave the amount, and the documents to bring.
